Interview with HMC
Interviews are reserved for current or rising seniors applying for first-year admission and are not required for your application or admission to the College.
Interviews must be completed before the deadline of the application round (ED1, ED2. RD) you intend to apply to.
We suggest reviewing our interview questions prior to your interview.
We recommend being familiar with HMC before you interview: Visit our campus, join us for an Online Information Session, or take a virtual tour
In lieu of a virtual interview, international applicants are encouraged to submit an InitialView or Vericant interview. InitialView and Vericant interviews are conducted by native English speakers and last an average of 15-20 minutes. A one-time fee is required, which allows the student to sent their interview to as many schools as they would like. Learn more about interview recommendations for international applicants on our interview website.
Prospective HMC students are only allowed to interview once with the College. Prospective students can complete an Online Interview OR an Alumni Interview, but not both.
Online Interviews
Online interviews are conducted by senior interns or admission officers and last approximately 30 minutes. Interviews are offered starting in mid-September and will be available until early December.
Note: If you do not see any available interviews on the calendar, this means they are all currently claimed. Interviews are optional in the Harvey Mudd College admission process, and we appreciate your understanding that we cannot interview every prospective applicant.
Please select a date on the calendar to view and register for events.
All events are listed in Pacific Time Zone.
Login information for your online interview will be provided in your confirmation email.

Alumni Interviews
Note: Alumni interviews for the 2026-2027 application cycle will open later this fall.
You will be matched with and arrange an interview with a trained alumni ambassador. Like online interviews, alumni interviews last approximately 30 minutes.
You can expect to be matched 7-10 business days after submitting your request.
You will be emailed their contact information once you are matched.
You will coordinate the date/time and platform directly with your interviewer.
